technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven as the build tool with multi-module project structure.
Use maven-shade-plugin with relocation configuration to prevent external libraries from overriding existing libraries in uber-jar.
For new projects (U2, U4), follow standard Spring project conventions with a separate Maven module.
Use Aether library for dependency resolution and add a flag to enable offline mode (U6).
Implement ModuleRegistry as a simple in-memory map-based registry (U7) with a defined interface.
Implement module commands (U8) using Spring Shell for CLI interaction.
Port SFTP module (U3) by extracting existing code from Spring XD and adapting it to Spring Cloud Stream APIs.
For processor OOTB modules (U5), create a foundation with an abstract base class and SPI-like discovery mechanism.
assumptions: The developer is highly proficient in Java, Spring Framework, Maven, and the specific projects involved (Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, Spring XD).
All source code repositories and build environments are already set up and accessible.
No major architectural changes are required beyond what is described in the user stories.
Existing unit and integration tests are in place and will be extended as part of the effort.
Effort estimates are based on a single developer working full-time (8-hour days) and include coding, unit testing, integration testing, and minimal documentation.
All user stories are independent and can be implemented in any order without significant blocking dependencies.
The developer does not need to perform extensive research or training.

activities.activity_description: Modify the build configuration (e.g., maven-shade-plugin) to prevent external libraries from overriding existing libraries in the uber-jar. Includes testing to verify the behavior.

activities.activity_name: Move external library to separate project
activities.activity_description: Create a new Maven module, move the external library code and its dependencies, update parent POM and inter-project references, and verify build and tests.

activities.activity_name: Port SFTP module from XD to s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Extract the SFTP source module from Spring XD, adapt it to the Spring Cloud Stream interface (e.g., MessageSource), write new unit and integration tests, and update documentation.
Create a new Maven project containing the @RedisRule contract and its associated rules, isolate from core functionalities, and ensure reusability. Includes moving existing code and writing tests.

activities.activity_name: Create foundation for processor OOTB modules
activities.activity_description: Design and implement an abstract base class or interface for processors, define a plugin/discovery mechanism, and provide a sample implementation. Includes unit tests.
Modify AetherModuleResolver to support an 'offline' flag that forces resolution from local Maven repository only. Update configuration handling and write tests.
Design a ModuleRegistry interface and implement an in-memory version that maps module names to coordinates. Include unit tests.
Implement four CLI commands (module info, module list, module register, module unregister) using Spring Shell or a similar framework, integrate with ModuleRegistry, and test each command.
Perform end-to-end integration testing to ensure all changes work together correctly, including build, runtime, and command interactions. Fix any discovered issues.
Update README files, wiki pages, or inline comments to reflect the new features, commands, and project structures.
